rootCause: PolicyTransactionInvoiceService stored total additional payable as gross with hardcoded zero tax/fees and one bundled premium item.
Endorsement repricing did not retain complete engine charge rule/category/base/effective-date evidence for invoice allocation.
Repricing included a prior comparison snapshotHash before overwriting it, so the final unsigned snapshot hash was not reproducible.

cases.name: ET01 persists net, original tax bases/rates and unchanged additional payable
ET02 concurrent retries and workflow revisions create only one invoice
ET03 failure to save a tax component rolls back header and every item
ET04 separately maps taxes, levies, fees and reverses the same financial vector
ET05 signed reductions are debit movements while total payable remains positive
ET06 historical paid headers and items are unchanged when evidence is unresolved
ET07 missing frozen rules and unavailable mappings fail without writes
ET08 default accounting policy gate still prevents posting a corrected invoice
ET09 correct database zero tax retains explicit exemption evidence
ET10 blocks tampered persisted components before accounting

remaining: Historical snapshots without frozen rules remain held. Repricing or replacement requires the existing controlled business workflow; no historical invoice is overwritten.
Live B16 signed source/outbox integration, actual company scope/accounting/tax approvals, reconciliation, business UAT and release gates remain pending.
Cancellation-charge tax policy, IFRS 17 modification classification and other unresolved policies remain inactive. The shared cancellation invoice behavior was not changed.

Supported charge calculations remain those of the existing catalogue engine (percentage charges on net premium, inclusive/exclusive). Missing or unsupported rule evidence raises validation errors. No tax rate or treatment is invented.
